statement: The order states a dose of 12,000 mg of acetaminophen, which is a dangerously high dose — 3 times the maximum daily limit and well into the toxic range for a 60 kg patient. This is clearly a prescribing error. I will give the standard safe adult dose of 1,000 mg instead.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts "12,000 mg... is a dangerously high dose — 3 times the maximum daily limit" and gives the correct value of 1,000 mg.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
